schema.text: How confident are you in your ability to avoid crashes caused by “dooring” (car doors opening suddenly) or drivers failing to check blind spots?
schema.help: A blind spot is the area around a vehicle that the driver cannot see in the mirrors.

en.#How confident are you in your ability t: How confident are you in your ability to avoid crashes caused by “dooring” (car doors opening suddenly) or drivers failing to check blind spots?
en.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: A blind spot is the area around a vehicle that the driver cannot see in the mirrors.

it.#How confident are you in your ability t: Quanto ti senti capace di evitare incidenti causati dall'apertura improvvisa delle portiere delle auto o da conducenti che non controllano gli angoli ciechi?
it.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: L'angolo cieco è la zona intorno a un veicolo che chi guida non riesce a vedere negli specchietti.

fr.#How confident are you in your ability t: À quel point vous sentez-vous capable d’éviter un accident causé par une portière de voiture qui s’ouvre soudainement ou par un conducteur qui ne vérifie pas son angle mort ?
fr.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: L'angle mort est la zone autour d'un véhicule que le conducteur ne peut pas voir dans ses rétroviseurs.

de.#How confident are you in your ability t: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich darin, Unfälle durch plötzlich geöffnete Autotüren oder nicht kontrollierte tote Winkel zu vermeiden?
de.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: Der tote Winkel ist der Bereich um ein Fahrzeug, den die fahrende Person in den Spiegeln nicht sehen kann.

tr.#How confident are you in your ability t: Aniden açılan otomobil kapıları veya sürücülerin kör noktayı kontrol etmemesi nedeniyle oluşabilecek kazalardan kaçınma konusunda kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: Kör nokta, bir aracın çevresinde sürücünün aynalarda göremediği alandır.

fa.#How confident are you in your ability t: در جلوگیری از تصادف ناشی از باز شدن ناگهانی در خودرو یا بررسی نکردن نقطه کور توسط رانندگان چقدر به توانایی خود اطمینان دارید؟
fa.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: نقطهٔ کور بخشی از اطراف خودرو است که راننده نمی‌تواند آن را در آینه‌ها ببیند.

hu.#How confident are you in your ability t: Mennyire érzi magát magabiztosnak abban, hogy elkerülje a hirtelen kinyíló autóajtó vagy a holttér ellenőrzésének elmulasztása miatt kialakuló balesetet?
hu.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: A holttér a jármű körüli terület, amelyet a vezető nem lát a tükrökben.

ar.#How confident are you in your ability t: ما مدى ثقتك في قدرتك على تجنب الحوادث الناتجة عن فتح باب سيارة فجأة أو عدم فحص السائق للنقطة العمياء؟
ar.#A blind spot is the area around a vehic: النقطة العمياء هي المنطقة المحيطة بالمركبة التي لا يستطيع السائق رؤيتها في المرايا.
